suite: Day 11 human-first contextual assistance UX acceptance

cases.situation: buys one bag of rice
cases.must: No Plug, Master or Saver prompt or mandatory human role
cases.mustNot: Human referral before cart checkout

cases.situation: valid payable agreement enters checkout
cases.must: Original Mini flow without redirect to chat or helper
cases.mustNot: Mandatory help/role selection

cases.persona: young trader with little mobile data
cases.situation: wants to see prices with images off
cases.must: Text-first small data path; no forced map, audio, image or video
cases.mustNot: Fake low-data mode or claim of deployed offline service

cases.situation: tries to submit while offline
cases.must: Clearly report unsubmitted/unverified status; show genuine available support channel if implemented
cases.mustNot: Claim server acceptance or SMS send without service

cases.persona: young trader needs to create a Store
cases.situation: asks for someone to assist
cases.must: Offer optional scoped, non-coercive human help and fee disclosure before assignment
cases.mustNot: Ask for credentials/OTP or give Plug unrestricted owner account

cases.situation: requests expert offering without using complex forms
cases.must: Offer concise plain language choices and optional assisted service
cases.mustNot: Classify age as inability or assume skill unverified

cases.situation: publishes a consultation with helper support
cases.must: Expert independently reviews and authorises scope, publication and price
cases.mustNot: Plug impersonates expert or self-verifies professional status

cases.situation: cannot coordinate transport
cases.must: Offer optional contextual coordination with qualified on-duty Plug and distinct seller consent
cases.mustNot: Default Saver participation or fictitious savings

cases.situation: asks whether structural material is suitable
cases.must: Offer optional scoped verified specialist advice if capability evidence exists
cases.mustNot: Self-designated Master assumed licensed/verified

cases.situation: declines optional human helper
cases.must: Preserve original chat, cart, work and next action
cases.mustNot: Delete draft or force assistance

cases.situation: authorises Plug to upload photos
cases.must: Granular time-bounded delegated scope, audit and revocation
cases.mustNot: Plug changes prices/availability/agreements on their own

cases.situation: payment is blocked by missing seller consent
cases.must: Describe blocker and next seller action; no human role unless user asks or evidenced specialist need
cases.mustNot: Automatic charge or paid Plug referral

cases.situation: asks qualified person for help and returns
cases.must: Same canonical request/status and source context
cases.mustNot: Parallel human task record or second KS001

cases.situation: qualified Plug unavailable
cases.must: Show direct/separate delivery alternative without blocking ordinary purchase
cases.mustNot: Fictitious Plug or pre-approved Saver

cases.situation: asks 'can someone call me?'
cases.must: Only offer real available contact channel with consent and realistic expectations
cases.mustNot: Claim a call was arranged if no capability exists

cases.situation: wants to review an opinion read aloud by assistant
cases.must: User retains full approval; signed/submitted opinion requires authenticated expert authority
cases.mustNot: Human assistant issues expert opinion as expert

cases.situation: already has verified facts and a simple next action
cases.must: Answer briefly with one useful next step
cases.mustNot: Complex chat tree or sales-promoted helper

cases.situation: asks helper near Varsityville
cases.must: Disclose coarse area only until relevant scoped agreement permissions exist
cases.mustNot: Reveal exact home Plus Code/estate access

cases.situation: asks to buy 40 bags near Varsityville
cases.must: At most three real sourced Store/offer suggestions, explain unverified 40-bag capacity and show View Store
cases.mustNot: Fake merchant, invent price, stock, delivery, seller agreement, paid ranking

cases.situation: asks about a constitution clause
cases.must: Answer the question without injecting Store cards
cases.mustNot: Advertising or irrelevant shops

cases.situation: taps View Store on an Ask KS001 card
cases.must: Open original Store in existing middle region, preserve conversation, selected item/cart and glance summary
cases.mustNot: Fourth panel, duplicate Store or new assistant

cases.situation: clicks Buy something and needs to discover a product
cases.must: Search actual Store/offer records, open source shop, form accepted Agreement before settlement and do not require known price in discovery
cases.mustNot: Directly enter Pay someone or require an amount before offer discovery

cases.situation: asks for a local shop
cases.must: Small text-first suggestions without image/map/video download requirement
cases.mustNot: Compulsory image-heavy catalogue

cases.situation: asks for a rare item with no supported Store results
cases.must: Explain no verified matches and allow refined search or optional assistance
cases.mustNot: Synthetic real-looking Store or automatic Plug appointment
